title: Small-data classifier
text: Abstract. We propose a neural network for medical image classification. The dataset contains 120 images. We compare against one baseline and report 99.8 percent accuracy. We do not provide confidence intervals or external validation. References. The approach uses a convolutional neural network.

title: RAG evaluation
text: Abstract. This paper evaluates retrieval augmented generation for question answering. We compare two retrievers on one benchmark with one random seed. We do not perform ablation studies. Dataset splits and hyperparameters are not fully documented. Results show a small improvement over the baseline.
